answer_1.quote: We frame this problem of recovering textual embeddings as a controlled generation problem, where we seek to generate text such that the text is as close as possible to a given embedding.

answer_2.quote: To measure this we use word-match metrics including: BLEU score, a measure of n-gram similarities between the true and reconstructed text; Token F1, the multi-class F1 score between the set of predicted tokens and the set of true tokens; Exact-match, the percentage of reconstructed outputs that perfectly match the ground-truth.
